title: alchemilla vulgaris subsp. lineata
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. lineata, commonly known as the Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herb native to Europe, Asia, and North America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues and menstrual problems. The health benefits of Lady's Mantle include reducing menstrual cramps and heavy bleeding, as well as soothing digestive issues such as diarrhea and irritable bowel syndrome. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins.
